import json
import subprocess

def get_issues(server):
    cmd = ["sonarless-mcp", "search-sonar-issues-in-projects", f"--server={server}"]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd="<world>/project")
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"Error querying {server}: {result.stderr}")
        return []
    try:
        data = json.loads(result.stdout)
        return data.get("issues", [])
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return []

local_issues = get_issues("local")
remote_issues = get_issues("work")

print(f"LOCAL ({len(local_issues)} issues):")
for issue in sorted(local_issues, key=lambda x: (x.get("file", ""), x.get("line", 0))):
    print(f"  {issue.get('file', 'unknown')}:{issue.get('line', '?')} [{issue.get('severity', '?')}] {issue.get('type', '')} - {issue.get('message', '')[:60]}")

print(f"\nREMOTE CI ({len(remote_issues)} issues):")
for issue in sorted(remote_issues, key=lambda x: (x.get("file", ""), x.get("line", 0))):
    print(f"  {issue.get('file', 'unknown')}:{issue.get('line', '?')} [{issue.get('severity', '?')}] {issue.get('type', '')} - {issue.get('message', '')[:60]}")

# Simple comparison
local_set = {(i.get('file'), i.get('line'), i.get('ruleId')) for i in local_issues}
remote_set = {(i.get('file'), i.get('line'), i.get('ruleId')) for i in remote_issues}

only_local = local_set - remote_set
only_remote = remote_set - local_set
both = local_set & remote_set

print(f"\nCOMPARISON:")
print(f"  Only in LOCAL: {len(only_local)}")
print(f"  Only in CI: {len(only_remote)}")
print(f"  In both: {len(both)}")
EOF
